decisions.reason: Launched only in 2023 with its own web page in a long-cycle space market, so its prospects remain uncertain and cheap to keep open, and it fits the firm's navigation and observation core.

The modular navigation camera matches the strategic push toward flexible, compact sensors for small satellites, and space qualification is a sunk cost, so the option is worth holding while customer adoption resolves.
Space situational awareness is a growing, agency-funded field where results take years to materialize, so keeping this low-cost option open preserves upside.

Although only mentioned on the website, suggesting an earlier stage, the miniaturized LiDAR builds on docking and navigation heritage and supports miniaturization goals, so it is too early to abandon the option.
